name: news_autosport_f1
note: First 15 items from the Autosport F1 news RSS feed, parsed from the raw XML into { title, link, isoDate, contentSnippet }. isoDate normalized to UTC ISO-8601 from the feed's RFC-822 pubDate. See fixtures/news/autosport_f1.raw.xml for the untouched source XML.

name: news_autosport_f1_raw
note: Raw, unmodified RSS XML as returned by Autosport. Source-of-truth for fixtures/news/autosport_f1.json.

name: kalshi_kxf1_markets
note: F1 2026 Drivers' Championship winner markets (event KXF1-26), 22 real tickers/titles/close_times/statuses. The API's cent-denominated yes_bid/yes_ask were null for every market at capture time (thin off-season book), so all 22 entries were demo-priced with plausible championship-odds cents and flagged _demo_priced: true. The live (near-zero/thin) yes_bid_dollars_live/yes_ask_dollars_live/liquidity_dollars_live fields are preserved alongside for provenance.
